Package index

Staggered adoption without covariates

Weights that a TWFE regression and the overall average treatment effects of Callaway and Sant’Anna (2021) place on group-time average treatment effects.

twfe_weights()
TWFE regression weights on group-time average treatment effects
attO_weights()
Weights behind the overall average treatment effect \(ATT^o\)
att_simple_weights()
Weights behind the simple overall average treatment effect

Covariates, two periods

TWFE regressions, AIPW, regression adjustment and inverse probability weighting as reweighting estimators, with covariate balance.

two_period_reg_weights()
Implicit weights from a two-period TWFE regression with covariates
two_period_aipw_weights()
Implicit weights from AIPW, regression adjustment or IPW with two periods

Covariates, staggered adoption

implicit_twfe_weights()
Implicit weights from a TWFE regression with covariates and staggered adoption
twfe_cov_bal()
Covariate balance from the implicit weights of a TWFE regression
summary(<decomposed_twfe>)
Summarize a TWFE decomposition
implicit_aipw_weights()
Implicit weights from AIPW or regression adjustment with staggered adoption
aipw_cov_bal()
Covariate balance from the implicit weights of AIPW or regression adjustment
summary(<decomposed_aipw>)
Summarize AIPW or regression adjustment weights

Plotting

ggtwfeweights()
Plot implicit weights or covariate balance
ggtwfeweights(<decomposed_aipw>)
Plot covariate balance for AIPW or regression adjustment weights
ggtwfeweights(<decomposed_twfe>)
Plot covariate balance for TWFE or AIPW implicit weights
ggtwfeweights(<mp_weights_obj>)
Plot weights on group-time average treatment effects
ggtwfeweights(<two_period_covs_obj>)
Plot covariate balance for two-period implicit weights

Balance statistics

Can be applied to any set of weights.

pooled_sd()
Pooled standard deviation of a covariate
log_ratio_sd()
Log ratio of standard deviations
frac_treated_extreme()
Fraction of treated units with extreme covariate values
effective_sample_size()
Effective sample size of a set of weights
